# Read-only creation confirmation recovery

In the b485ed71 fresh Windows test, the ordinary blank-world form was submitted and the world record was durably created. The following operator world.list read hit the plugin CoreClient's existing five-second timeout and prematurely ended the test. Read-only inspection after normal shutdown found the selected world and a fast list response. This did not prove initialization completed: the normal shutdown had cancelled the still-initializing world, and the ordinary UI subsequently showed Cancelled and Retry initialization. No model request was made. The original logs do not identify the exact preceding Core request; increased asset inventory is not an established cause.

The test operator now reuses P8's exact transient read-timeout classification only while confirming an already submitted blank, example or library-template creation. It polls the normal navigation list again; it never resubmits creation. Preserve UI errors, unknown transport errors, malformed lists, failed/cancelled/interrupted rows and unexpected multiple worlds. Only the actual newly created selected ready world completes confirmation.

For retained-world runtime readiness, inspect the target row before polling the runtime. A cancelled/failed/interrupted world may have no runtime; report its real terminal state and diagnostics immediately instead of endlessly accepting No world runtime as temporary. Even diagnostics containing a normally transient phrase must not hide that terminal state. Initialization retry remains an explicit ordinary UI action by the operator, never an automatic action of this helper.

Reuse the operator's existing cancellation and desktop-exit handling; do not import P8's separate deadline or add request/model/task budgets. Store retry count and the last precise timeout in the operator report. Production RPC timeouts and application behavior are unchanged. This corrects a test-confirmation false failure, not evidence of a repaired rendering or world-creation failure.

Run node --test tests/operator-world-initialization.test.mjs tests/operator-blank-world.test.mjs tests/player-feedback/P8/initialization-poll.test.mjs. Controlled read sequences cover delayed readiness, exact and lookalike timeout errors, terminal initialization, selection, cancellation and no create/write callbacks. The coordinating real-player run separately continues the preserved world through ordinary UI actions.
